title: Identification of microRNA-93-5P Binding Site on BMP-2 mRNA 3'UTR Using Psicheck2.0 Vector and Luciferase System
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.irbcd2n
materials: Change to serum deprived media. Day

Thaw dual-luciferase reporter reagents. Flash and prime Berthold luminometer with firefly luciferase and renilla luciferase substrate reagents.Read firefly and renilla luciferase signals (firefly luciferase signal is detected at 560 nm and renilla luciferase signal is detected at 480 nm).

steps.title: Synthesize DNA and subclone into vector
steps.instruction: Synthesize the DNA sequence encoding the BMP‑2 3′UTR region and subclone it into the psicheck‑2.0 luciferase reporter vector.

steps.title: Lyse bacteria and harvest plasmid
steps.instruction: Lyse the transformed bacteria and purify the recombinant psicheck‑2.0 plasmid using a standard plasmid miniprep procedure.

steps.title: Prepare and expand cell culture
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen cells in a 37 °C water bath, centrifuge at 1,500 × g for 5 min, aspirate the supernatant, resuspend the pellet, and plate the cells into a T75 culture flask; incubate at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂, split the culture at ~60 % confluency, and subculture 1–2 times before the assay.

substeps.instruction: Thaw cells in a 37 °C water bath
Plate into a T75 flask and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂

steps.title: Plate cells for assay
steps.instruction: Plate the expanded cells into 24‑well plates as triplicate wells for each experimental condition, using the same seeding density as determined previously.

steps.title: Day 0 – Seed cells
steps.instruction: Seed cells in each well with 500 μl complete growth medium (DMEM + 10 % FBS).

steps.title: Day 1 – Transfect with reporter and miRNA
steps.instruction: Transfect each well with 3 μg psicheck‑2.0 plasmid, 50 nM microRNA‑93 mimic, and 2.5 μl Lipofectamine 2000, following the transfection reagent protocol.

steps.title: Day 2 – Change media
steps.instruction: Twelve hours after transfection, replace the medium with fresh complete growth medium.

steps.title: Day 3 – Serum‑starve cells
steps.instruction: Replace the medium with serum‑deprived medium (e.g., DMEM without FBS).

steps.title: Day 5 – Lyse cells
steps.instruction: Lyse the cells using the appropriate luciferase assay lysis buffer according to the luciferase system protocol.
